# All icons

Every icon that ships with `@dextinity/ui`, by category, with its name for `<Icon name="…" />` and its search terms. The icons are lines on a 24×24 grid with a 1.5 stroke and round ends, without duotone fills.

See [Icon](?path=/docs/foundations-icons-icon--docs) for how to use the `Icon` component. To replace or add icons, see [Customize icons](?path=/docs/foundations-icons-customize-icons--docs).

<Canvas of={AllIconsStories.AllIcons} sourceState="none" />

## Deprecated names

The names of the COMET icon set and the earlier names of `@dextinity/ui` still work and show the icon they point to. They are deprecated: use the name of the icon instead. To replace such an icon, set the variable of the icon, e.g. `--dextinity-icon-trash` for `delete`: it replaces the icon under both names. A variable set under the earlier name, e.g. `--dextinity-icon-delete`, still wins for that name.
